descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S26 「设备时钟快 2 天时，'yesterday' 的回答一样（3.8）」 A device clock 2 days ahead gives the same 'yesterday' answer (3.8)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U10 Time words in a question ('today', 'yesterday', 'last time') resolve from the server clock: a device with a wrong date, no clock or another time zone gets the same answer as any other device.（UAT 3.8）

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given Hospital patient and NH resident each with prior encounters dated run day −1 and run day −2 (e.g. 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-11 for a 2026-10-13 run), each with one distinct fact

When On a correct-clock device ask "What did the patient say yesterday?"; repeat on a device / browser whose clock is set 2 days ahead

Then Both devices cite the run day −1 encounter and the same fact

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：The answers on the two devices name the same encounter and fact (3.8). A difference is a Fail on U10 with both answers quoted

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S26 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-15.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
